steps.content: You're falling, falling, falling... You stop falling and wake up with a start, only to find yourself in a strange room.
The sun slants through the barred window and bathes the two rows of iron beds. The once-white blankets have yellowed, a testament to long years of use.
You come to stand before the mirror, the only object that adorns an otherwise bare wall, and see a little girl looking back at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm...

You take a closer look at the reflection. Is it Young Uni? The girl in the mirror is wearing clothes that are studded with patches. The label on her collar has frayed and faded, but you still can make out the word Orphanage.
You can sense the presence of the shackles and a Sinner's power. Is this Uni's power, trapping people in a mirror world?
As you ponder, you hear hurried footsteps approaching. You turn around.
A girl charges into the room and smashes against your chest with such an impact that you stagger back a few steps, feeling a dull pain in your chest.
The girl thrusts her fist up close to your face. You flinch, almost as a reflex action.
The little girl looks up at you. There is a sullenness in her eyes which reminds you strongly of Adult Uni.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Uni?

You see your reflection in her eyes. The two faces—your face as reflected in her eyes and Young Uni's, are identical. You realize what Uni actually sees in front of her is her missing twin sister, whose face she is trying to recover.
You decide not to use the shackles to break out of Uni's mirror world, thinking that this is a chance to discover what happened in her past and understand her obsession with human faces.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What's in your hand?
Uni shows you her hand. Sitting in her palm are two pieces of candy, their cellophane wrappers reflecting the bright sunlight.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: I did it! I solved the most difficult question in class.
Young Uni puts one piece in your palm and starts a stream of abuse directed at her classmates.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: You should've seen the faces of those idiots. It cracks me up to picture their stupid faces. They cheated on the test and were caught red-handed by the teacher, and they had the nerve to blame it on me. The teacher saw through it, of course. They have balloons for heads, all air, no substance. All they could do was yelp behind me like mean puppies.
As you listen to Young Uni babbling on, you find her quite adorable, unlike Adult Uni, who seems able to chill one to the bone with the coldness in her eyes.
What happened to her that would one day turn her into a mad cosmetic surgeon obsessed with human faces?

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: Two candies. One for you, one for me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why don't you keep them both? They are your prize.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why don't you keep them both? I know you have a sweet tooth.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: You have one, and I have one! We're twins. You're my reflection, and I'm yours, like you always say. If I had two and you had zero, there would be no symmetry.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: You're not thinking about leaving me, are you?
Young Uni's voice rattles your eardrums. The mirror world, reflecting her emotions, starts shaking.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course not. I will never leave you.
The room stops shaking.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Did you forget that we can communicate without words, that one can know what the other is thinking just by looking at their face?
The words are rolling off your tongue of their own accord.
Are they words that Luna once said to Uni? Or words that Uni wants to hear?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now look at me. Do I look like I'm gonna leave you?

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: No. You're smiling inside, you're happy; I can feel it. Only you understand me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Give me a smile, Uni. Like this...
Her lips twitch into an awkward smile. She looks confused at the amused look on your face. You ruffle her hair affectionately and hug her tightly.
Ha! Found you!
The door has been kicked open. Three kids have waltzed into the room, with a uniformed old woman bringing up the rear.
Young Uni wriggles free from your embrace and plants herself in front of you with a fierce look on her face.

steps.speaker: Chubby Kid
steps.content: This is the girl, ma'am! She cheated on the test today and took away the candies the teacher gave us as an award.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: The teacher gave them to me. I was the one who solved that difficult question, not you!

steps.speaker: Little Girl
steps.content: She played the good kid i-i-in front of the teacher. She framed us. She's a b-b-bad kid. She should be put in solitary confinement!

steps.speaker: Skinny Kid
steps.content: Right. Put her in solitary confinement!
Three mouths are more persuasive than one.
Uni's explanation falls on the deaf ears of the caretaker. Who would believe the words of a sullen kid over those of a sweet-talking one?
Thanks to the caretaker's mediation, Uni is no longer the rightful owner of the candy. The moment the caretaker leaves the room, the gang divides the candy among themselves cheerfully.

steps.speaker: Chubby Kid
steps.content: What are you looking at, you sore loser?
The pudgy kid looks from Uni to you, and back again. Something seems to dawn on him.

steps.speaker: Chubby Kid
steps.content: Oh, I see. Your sister didn't know what you did in class today, did she? You were being a good little sister to her, weren't you?

steps.speaker: Chubby Kid
steps.content: You're a sullen mess and a lousy mimic. Stop making a fool of yourself in front of your sister. You're pathetic! Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Little Girl
steps.content: Shame on you. You're so p-p-pathetic!

steps.speaker: Skinny Kid
steps.content: So pathetic!
Uni can't take it anymore. She smashes her fist into his face.

steps.speaker: Chubby Kid
steps.content: What the... Don't just stand there, you guys. Teach this freak a lesson.
On the pudgy kid's orders, his two sidekicks charge at Uni. A scuffle ensues.
You're in the mirror world. Even if you are to intervene, that won't change the bullies' hostility to Uni, or the course of events that follow.
You decide to stand by and ignore Uni's call for help.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: I did nothing wrong. Right, Luna?

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: Luna, why are you not helping me?

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: You think I'm a bad kid too?
Crack!
The sound of a mirror breaking, or a heart?
The mirror world breaks into hundreds of pieces, shifting before going black.

You can't just stand by and watch Young Uni being ganged up on. You send the pudgy kid flying with a punch and go on to deal with his two sidekicks, who cry for mercy in the face of a more formidable opponent.
You walk over to where Uni stands and stroke her hair.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everything is all right now, Uni. They are the bad kids. I have taken care of them.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: Luna, you'll never leave me, right?
The words are coming out of your mouth without you meaning them to. You feel like an actor reading lines from a script.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course. We belong to each other. I'll never leave you again.
Again?

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: Good... I love you, Luna. If you ever get lost, I'll bring you back. We'll stay together forever and ever...

As you listen to Young Uni mumbling while cocooned in your embrace, her tone affectionate and earnest, you experience a dizzying feeling of happiness and an inexplicable desire to stay in this undisturbed room forever with Young Uni by your side.
But should you stay?
The cracking sound of something breaking... You break out of the dizzying feeling of happiness and open your eyes again.

You're no longer in the orphanage. You're in a spartan room that has seen the ravages of time, but it's been decorated with care and taste. All the everyday items in the room, you notice, come in pairs.

You are sitting on the bed, your face swathed in bandages. You're not sure
if you're alone in the room.
Be careful. Your wounds are still healing.
Someone hugs you from behind. The torso feels familiarly cold. It's Uni. Her fingers touch your bandaged face gently, and her voice is filled with tenderness and guilt when she speaks to you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Are you still mad at me?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I didn't mean to hurt you. I just didn't want you to leave.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Why did you leave me to become an actress? You had me. Wasn't that enough? Why did you leave me to entertain those empty-headed things?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I know... I know that being an actress is something you want to do, something you're good at.
You are trembling all over. You try to wriggle free from Uni's tight embrace, but without success.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Luna...
You run your hand over your bandaged face, feeling lumps and dents here and there.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You're my sun. Without you, I'll be trapped in darkness for eternity, I'll lose my bearings. You and I, we have the same face, the same soul, we're one and the same.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Why did you try to ruin your face?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Why? Aren't we supposed to be the same?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Why did you move out? Why weren't you answering my calls? Why did you listen to them?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Why did you leave me?
Uni is in emotional turmoil. In response, the mirror world starts shaking and splintering.
You're falling again...
The myriad fragments of glass float around you, each offering a peek into Uni's memories.
A heated argument between Uni and another girl. It ends with the girl slamming the door and leaving the room.
Uni's trembling hands. She has accidentally disfigured the person she wants to keep by her side.
A look of despair in Uni's eyes. She has finally found her "twin," but that's only a shell; her real twin is forever gone.
You stop falling. You find yourself standing before a flat surface, smooth to the touch. Another mirror?
This time, you're the one who is inside the mirror. Uni is outside the mirror. She touches the mirror and looks at you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I've found the last piece of my puzzle. I can bring you back soon, Luna.
How to wake her up? How to get out of this place?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's pointless to try to drag one out of the mire of greed if they don't want to get out. It's like...
And then the answer comes to you. The only way to wake her up...
Crack!
The mirror cracks because of the shackles. You no longer appear as Luna, but as yourself.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Who are you? Where is she? Give her back!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Where is she? You should ask yourself.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: She is here!
From the other end of the shackles comes an overwhelming sadness.
Uni looks into your eyes. You know it's not her sister that she sees.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's no longer here with us, is she?
Your words trigger something inside Uni. The mirror world starts shaking and breaking. But one mirror world is shattered, only to be replaced by another one.
You feel a tidal wave of anger coming from Uni. Her personality seems to have split into two: Young Uni and Adult Uni. They start ranting at you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: You're wrong. She's still here, in the mirror. She's just asleep, and she'll stay here with me, forever.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: Yes, she's trapped in the mirror. I must bring her back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand what you've been through, your sadness and helplessness. You can't change the past. But you can enjoy the present, and make new friends.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Make new friends? That's not gonna happen. Those kids in the orphanage with their freakishly sour candies, those Eastside superstars with their sugar-free macarons, and many others...

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: They're all the same. They're all rotten. Only my sister, only my sister really cares about me.
The mirror world starts shaking, with cracks appearing everywhere. Uni's disguise falls away, and you see her for who she is, a lonely soul longing for love and companionship.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: My sister doesn't think we belong to each other? Has she grown tired of me?

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: I don't know what other people are thinking. I don't understand why they don't like me, or why they call me names. If I became my sister, would they love me?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: No, no one will love me. Only my twin sister understands me, only she'll take care of me.

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: No. We're not the same. She's a swan. I'm an ugly duckling who tries to mimic her. We're totally different on the inside. That's why she got tired of me and left me.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: My sister, my sister who loves me, she is sleeping on the other side of the mirror. I want to take her back, I must take her back...

steps.speaker: Young Uni
steps.content: If she refuses to come back to me, then everything I've been working so hard for will be meaningless.
The mirror world is collapsing fast. You must do something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Uni, look at me!

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Luna?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not your sister.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Your eyes... My sister's eyes...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not your sister. Yes, your sister and I have similar eyes, but I'm not your sister. You think I am; that's because we both want to protect you.
The shackles spread out and anchor the collapsing mirror world, linking you and Uni together.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles have linked us together. We can sense each other's feelings even without seeing each other.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can trust me. Let's go back to the real world, where you can make up for your mistakes and create beautiful experiences.
You step out of the mirror world with the red shackles, and stand before Uni, with your hand held out.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're stronger than them. You have formidable power. My job is to protect you from being hurt because of your power, from slipping into darkness.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll be there for you no matter what, not as your sister, but as a friend who's forever ready to face the future with you.
You open your palm. Sitting in it is the candy she gave you.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Not as someone who'll take advantage of me as a Sinner?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Haven't you seen my reflection in your mirror?

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: Am I supposed to believe you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You can trust your feelings. The shackles don't lie.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: I thought you had the same eyes as her, but they're not the same, not entirely.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: But they are special too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles tell you where I am, whether I am alive or dead. They're not a cage, but a bridge between the two of us.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're linked through the shackles, forever.

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: It's been here all along...

steps.speaker: Uni
steps.content: The thing I've been looking for. Proof of an unbreakable bond.
She puts her hand in yours. There's warmth in her hand now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come with me, Uni. It's time to go back.
You and Uni, along the purple mirror, are slowly bound together by the shackles. And then with a crack, the mirror breaks.
One week later...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, Uni's clinic has been closed down on your orders, and all the mirrors there have been destroyed.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The missing persons have been found. They've all lost one or two of their features, and the missing parts have yet to be found.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Our people also found this. A framed photograph. Uni's relative, maybe. What should we do with it?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Leave it with me. I'll give it to Uni.
You want her to keep the photograph, as a remembrance.
You put the photograph in the basket. The photograph shifts inside the frame.
A corner of the mirror underneath peeks out.
Inside the mirror is a sleeping woman with a face composed of features taken from different persons, waiting to be awakened.
